localizedValues.name: G2
localizedValues.description:
Group Camp 2 also known as B2. No Amplified Music will be allowed in group camp areas. There are four utility stands that come with the rental. Due to irrigation schedule, please contact ranger for tent placement area. B2 has a private restroom with showers for the group renting the camp. Renters are required to clean the facilities while they are occupying the site. A cleaning supply cabinet will be provided at check-in and an inspection will be done at check-out.
There is a minimum billable party size for this site. The unit price for a block of people may not accurately reflect the total price required. Confirm total payment at checkout.

localizedValues.name: G1
localizedValues.description:
Group Camp 1 also known as A1. No Amplified Music will be allowed in group camp areas. There are three utility stands for RVs that come with rental. Due to irrigation schedule, please contact ranger for tent placement area. A1 has a private restroom with showers for the group renting the camp. Renters are required to clean the facilities while they are occupying the site. A cleaning supply cabinet will be provided at check-in and an inspection will be done at check-out.
There is a minimum billable party size for this site. The unit price for a block of people may not accurately reflect the total price required. Confirm total payment at checkout.

This campsite is located on the island. It is a designated walk-in site. No vehicles are allowed at the campsite. Campers must walk 1/4 of a mile from the dedicated parking lot to access the site. Be prepared to haul your gear in. Wheel carts may be available to assist with hauling gear, but they are limited and available on a first-come, first-served basis.
Free boat mooring.
Campsites are watered Monday through Friday. Check the information board in the camping area for schedule and details.
